chapter: Beginnings and early New Orleans scene
title: Dance halls and piano players like Plutzum and the Fraziers
summary: Talk of Economy Hall and dance promoters, then more pianists: the humpbacked Plutzum, Simon, Mitchell and Boynell Frazier, and Red Toots.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah, on a Christmas day, she was making babies on Christmas day. Put you on a pillow, if I miss you, I don't want them the most. And then play that number around 12 o'clock at night and after a while you're going to see somebody hit the floor, they all get drunk and then that's the time right here at the place of various, it's a church now. The new hall, the old teaching hall, the economy hall, where we left from Sunday, where they toured that church down. Yeah, I know. And at the Copper Raiders, which, what you call them, he promoted a lot of dances. And I read Toots and Trimble Paul and Plutzum. There was another piano player from back there too. Plutzum? Plutzum. Remember his humpback head, he used to be like that?
He was humpback, red, and a little short neck like that. He used to play very hard. Plutzum.
I don't think I ever knew him. He probably played.

He was way back. He was the one from way back. He died. Yeah, Plutzum. He would tie him up with Simon and Mitchell Frazier and all them, and Elliott Frazier and all them boys played piano. What you know about that? And Simon always was a good man. Simon left the liquor kit. But Boynell and Mitchell was two stars. They worked together on the same piano. And they fit right together, huh?
That's right, right together. Well Mitchell must have been good if he
could play with Bernal. Oh yeah. Mitchell was great, man. Wonderful man.

Well how was Red Toots then? Red Toots, he was good. That's Washington, the guy that lives up in Shrewsbury. Yeah. Yeah, he's back in the union now. He just came back. He and Teddy Johnson just came back. Yeah. I got a little work together, I think. But anyhow, you were saying those guys would hit the floor?
